title: pilosella setifolia
intro: Pilosella setifolia, commonly known as Woolly Mouse-ear, is a plant species belonging to the dandelion family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects, contributing to its potential health benefits such as reducing inflammation and improving immune function. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial properties, and act as an antioxidant. The bioactive constituents of Pilosella setifolia include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
